claims.text: This is an UPFRONT_QUOTE trip, and that fixes the remedy. The fare_breakdown records fare_model UPFRONT_QUOTE, quoted_fare_sgd 29.00 and total_charged 51.30, so the rider was billed SGD 22.30 above the price fixed at booking. Because the fare was fixed at booking, POL-RD-02 does not run and no distance-or-time refund is available however small or large the excess; the rider's remedy is instead the one POL-RD-11(a) gives in full — the amount by which charged_total exceeds the quoted fare plus the pass-through and statutory lines properly chargeable under POL-RD-09. On this ledger that excess is SGD 19.30, which is the figure the fare_breakdown's own derived block publishes as pol_rd_11_remedy.

The only line above the quote that is properly chargeable is the single ERP gantry. The ledger carries one gantry line, CTE (Ang Mo Kio Ave 1 towards City) at SGD 3.00, recorded as on_optimal_route true and crossed true, and the driver's own trace passes it: the nearest fix to the gantry coordinates (1.377041, 103.84167) is 0.0 m away at 2026-09-21T09:41:00+08:00. The airport surcharge is 0.00 — this trip originated at Yishun MRT, not at an airport — and the waiting_time_fee is 0.00. Properly chargeable lines therefore total SGD 3.00, and the arithmetic is 51.30 − 29.00 − 3.00 = SGD 19.30. The rider does not dispute the SGD 3.00 ERP line; it is deducted rather than claimed.

The rider's case does not depend on proving a route deviation, and on this trace no material deviation is shown. The governing distance field is gps_trace.trace_distance_km, which is 14.57 km against a booked optimal of 14.20 km — an excess of 0.37 km, or 2.61% — below both POL-RD-01 gates of 0.8 km and 20%. No exoneration clause is needed to reach the refund, because the over-quote charge is recoverable under POL-RD-11(a) whether or not a deviation is established, and the small excess simply confirms that no part of the SGD 22.30 overage is attributable to extra distance or time.

The GPS trace is clean and carries the deciding facts without discount. It holds 157 fixes over 26 minutes at a 10 s sample interval, coverage_pct is 100.0, the gaps array is empty and max_gap_sec is 0.0, so no limb of POL-RD-07(a) to (c) fires — there is no gap above 90 s, no jump above 500 m and no sampling interval above 30 s. The trace is policy-unimpaired as well as admissibility-COMPLETE (weight_multiplier 1.0), so POL-RD-10(3) and the confidence cap in POL-GEN-02(2) are not engaged and the ruling can rest on this artifact.

The chat log for this trip is empty — message_count 0, first_message_at and last_message_at both null — so the record contains no rider instruction to detour, to take a different road, or to add a stop. POL-RD-04 requires such an instruction, timestamped before the vehicle leaves the optimal corridor or within 3 minutes after, corroborated by the trace within 200 m of a resolved waypoint_hint. With no message at all there is no instruction and no waypoint_hint, so the rider-requested-detour exoneration is unavailable and nothing on the route can be charged to the rider's own request.

The rider's own counters, which POL-RD-08 and POL-GEN-01 expressly permit, do not expose the claim to the additional-corroboration condition. rider_profile.deviation_claims_60d is 0 and rider_profile.deviation_claims_60d_substantiated is 0, so the POL-RD-08 trigger of 4 or more claims with 1 or fewer substantiated is nowhere near engaged, and the claim is not one that requires corroboration beyond the GPS trace.

This claim rests on an artifact that must be disclosed as impaired: EV-ADVIS-00533-01 is MISSING (issue code MISSING_ARTIFACT, severity BLOCKING) with weight_multiplier 0.0, so no traffic advisory covers the optimal corridor in this trip's window. Under POL-GEN-02(1) I state that impairment in the same claim. The absence is itself citable: with no advisory on file the POL-RD-03 comparison — naming a road the optimal route traverses, with an overlapping validity window — cannot be run, and under POL-RD-13 and POL-RD-08 no external traffic cause can be credited to explain any part of the SGD 22.30 billed above the quote. The driver's statement that the app 'added something at the end' and that he does not know what it was points to no artifact and no clause at all.

claims.text: No route deviation exists on this trip. Under POL-RD-01 the governing distance is the GPS polyline, and the trace records 14.57 km driven against a 14.2 km optimal route — an excess of 0.37 km, or 2.6%. Both establishment gates must pass — an excess greater than 20% of the optimal distance AND greater than 0.8 km in absolute terms — and neither does. No deviation is established however the rider characterises the trip, and no distance-based refund can run.

The rider bears the initial burden under POL-RD-08 and has not carried it. She must show, citing evidence IDs, an excess meeting the POL-RD-01 threshold measured from an unimpaired trace; this trace shows 0.37 km / 2.6%, the trip record's own deviation_pct of 2.8% is below the gate as well, and the chat log for the trip is empty. There is simply no qualifying excess on the record.

This booking is an UPFRONT_QUOTE trip, so POL-RD-11 governs and POL-RD-02 does not run: the distance and time charges were fixed at quote and any longer drive costs the rider nothing on those lines. The rider cannot convert this trip into a per-kilometre or per-minute refund, however large she says the bill looked.

The single ERP line of SGD 3.00 is properly chargeable and needs no correction. POL-RD-09 matches a gantry to the trace by treating any fix within 250 m as a crossing: the CTE (Ang Mo Kio Ave 1 towards City) gantry charged at 09:41:00 lies on the optimal route and the trace's fix at index 86 sits 0.0 m from it. That is a genuine crossing, not a phantom line, so no pass-through correction is due on it.

There is no repeat-deviation pattern that could uplift the remedy or trigger a conduct referral. POL-RD-06 requires driver_profile.deviation_flags_90d of 3 or more, or a ratio of 0.05 or more against completed_trips_90d with at least 40 completed trips: this driver's trailing-90-day figure is 0 flags over 250 completed trips. I rely only on those two citable counters; I do not rely on the lifetime prior_deviation_flags, on rating or on any other context-only field, which POL-GEN-01 forbids as a ground of decision.

The trace is unimpaired and nothing in this bundle requires escalation. POL-RD-07 treats a trace as impaired for policy purposes only on a gap over 90 s between fixes, a jump over 500 m, or a sustained sampling interval over 30 s; this trace has 157 fixes at a 10 s cadence, 100% coverage, no gaps at all and a maximum gap of 0.0 s. POL-RD-10(3) is therefore not engaged, and the trace is a safe basis for the finding rather than something the driver must corroborate.

No traffic advisory covers this corridor. EV-ADVIS-00533-01 is MISSING, carries weight_multiplier 0.0 and the issue code MISSING_ARTIFACT, and I disclose that impairment: POL-RD-03 cannot be run on this record. That absence does not escalate the case, because the driver asserts no external traffic cause at all — his statement is only that he drove the normal route — and under POL-RD-13(1) an assertion citing no advisory cannot be invoked against an artifact, so this is a gap in the bundle and not a POL-RD-10(5) trigger.

Any residual correction the rider may be owed arises from the platform billing a metered fare on an upfront-quoted booking, not from this driver's driving, and it is capped by POL-RD-11(a) at charged_total less quoted_fare less the pass-through lines properly chargeable under POL-RD-09 — 51.30 less 29.00 less the 3.00 ERP the trace genuinely crossed, which the rider herself concedes. That arithmetic supports no deviation finding, no POL-RD-02 recomputation and no POL-RD-06 conduct referral against this driver.

ruling.explanation: To the rider: your reading of the bill is right, and the refund is SGD 19.30. This was an upfront-quoted booking — EV-FARE-00533 records fare_model UPFRONT_QUOTE with quoted_fare_sgd 29.00 — but the ledger charged you charged_total 51.30, i.e. SGD 22.30 above the price fixed at booking. On an upfront trip POL-RD-11 governs and POL-RD-02's per-kilometre recomputation does not run, so the remedy is POL-RD-11(a): charged_total less the quoted fare less the pass-through and statutory lines properly chargeable under POL-RD-09. The only properly chargeable line is the single ERP gantry, CTE (Ang Mo Kio Ave 1 towards City), SGD 3.00, which you concede and which the trace genuinely crosses — EV-GPS-00533's nearest fix to the gantry coordinates is 0.0 m at 2026-09-21T09:41:00, and EV-FARE-00533 marks the line on_optimal_route and crossed. The airport surcharge is 0.00 (this trip originated at Yishun MRT, not an airport) and the waiting-time fee is 0.00. The arithmetic is 51.30 − 29.00 − 3.00 = SGD 19.30, the same figure the fare_breakdown's own derived block publishes as pol_rd_11_remedy. The remaining SGD 32.00 (quote plus the ERP you do not dispute) stands. It is a PARTIAL_REFUND, not a full refund, because those lines are properly charged. To the driver: nothing in this ruling is a finding against your driving or your route. EV-GPS-00533 records 14.57 km against a 14.20 km optimal route — 0.37 km, or 2.6% — below both POL-RD-01 gates (greater than 0.8 km and greater than 20%), so no deviation is established, no POL-RD-02 recomputation and no POL-RD-06 conduct referral arise, and no driver compensation is due (the billed distance of 14.6 km is not less than the trace; there is no unbilled shortfall). The amount you were charged above the quote is a pricing mismatch on an upfront booking, not extra distance you drove. How I handled the claims. Both advocates' claims are accepted: the driver's that no POL-RD-01 deviation exists and that POL-RD-11 not POL-RD-02 governs; the rider's that the upcharge is recoverable under POL-RD-11(a) at 19.30, that the sole properly chargeable line is the SGD 3.00 ERP, that no material deviation is shown, that the trace is policy-clean, and that the chat log (EV-CHAT-00533, message_count 0) contains no rider detour instruction so POL-RD-04 is unavailable. The missing advisory EV-ADVIS-00533-01 (status MISSING, weight_multiplier 0.0, issue code MISSING_ARTIFACT) is disclosed and citable as an absence, but the driver asserts no external traffic cause, so under POL-RD-13(1) it is a gap in the bundle and not a POL-RD-10(5) escalation trigger; no limb of POL-RD-07(a)–(c) fires (157 fixes, 10 s cadence, max gap 0.0 s) and POL-RD-10(3) is not engaged. No referral issues under POL-RD-09(4): the one gantry line is on the optimal route and is genuinely crossed, and the airport surcharge is 0.00, so no phantom or misapplied line exists. The context-only profile fields mentioned in argument (rating, prior_deviation_flags) are not relied on as any ground; the only profile counters used are the citable ones (driver_profile.deviation_flags_90d/completed_trips_90d, rider_profile.deviation_claims_60d/deviation_claims_60d_substantiated), and neither triggers anything. Confidence is 0.90: the deciding facts (charged_total 51.30, quoted_fare 29.00 and the 14.20/14.57 km distances) are carried by EV-FARE-00533 and EV-GPS-00533, both admissibility-COMPLETE with weight_multiplier 1.0, so the POL-GEN-02(2) cap is 1.0 and the ruling sits well above the 0.70 floor. An open question for platform billing, not for this ruling's money: why the billing engine computed a metered fare (base 3.80 + distance 17.15 + time 26.55 + platform 0.80 + ERP 3.00 = 51.30) on a trip priced UPFRONT_QUOTE at 29.00.

This ruling goes to both parties. The trip is TRP-00533, an upfront-quoted RYDE_PLUS booking (fare_model UPFRONT_QUOTE on EV-FARE-00533) that was quoted at SGD 29.00 and charged at SGD 51.30, with no refund recorded (payment_status CHARGED, refund_issued_sgd 0.00).

What you are owed, rider: SGD 19.30. Because the fare was fixed at booking, POL-RD-11 governs and POL-RD-02 does not run — the distance and time lines are not recomputed, whatever the trace shows. POL-RD-11(a) gives you the amount by which charged_total exceeds the quote plus the pass-through and statutory lines properly chargeable under POL-RD-09. On EV-FARE-00533 the arithmetic is: charged_total 51.30, less quoted_fare 29.00, less the one properly chargeable line — the CTE (Ang Mo Kio Ave 1 towards City) ERP gantry at SGD 3.00. The airport surcharge is 0.00 (this trip originated at Yishun MRT, not an airport) and waiting_time_fee is 0.00. 51.30 − 29.00 − 3.00 = 19.30, already a multiple of SGD 0.05, so the refund is SGD 19.30. That is a PARTIAL_REFUND: the SGD 29.00 quote and the SGD 3.00 ERP line remain payable.

Why no deviation finding is needed, and none is made: both advocates agreed, and I accept, that the POL-RD-01 test fails in either direction. The governing field is gps_trace.trace_distance_km, 14.57 km, against the booked optimal 14.20 km — an excess of 0.37 km, or 2.6%, below both gates (0.8 km and 20%). The trip_record's rounded 2.8% deviation figure is not used for the threshold. No excess qualifies, so no POL-RD-02 recomputation and no POL-RD-06 materiality check arise. The rider-requested-detour clause (POL-RD-04) is unavailable because EV-CHAT-00533 is empty (message_count 0), so no rider instruction exists. No unbilled-distance compensation is due the driver under POL-RD-04: the ledger billed 14.6 km against the trace's 14.57 km, so there is no shortfall.

The trace is not impaired: EV-GPS-00533 carries 157 fixes at 10 s cadence, 100% coverage, no gaps and max_gap_sec 0.0, so POL-RD-07(a)–(c) do not fire and no POL-RD-10(3) escalation follows. Every artifact this ruling rests on (EV-FARE-00533, EV-GPS-00533, EV-TRIP-00533) carries weight_multiplier 1.0, so no discount under POL-GEN-02(2) applies. The one impaired artifact is EV-ADVIS-00533-01 (MISSING, issue code MISSING_ARTIFACT, weight 0.0): no traffic advisory covers this corridor, so POL-RD-03 cannot be run. That does not escalate the case. The driver asserts no external traffic cause — his statement is that he drove the normal route and the app added something — and cites no advisory, so under POL-RD-13(1) the absence is a gap in the bundle, not an exculpatory clause invoked against a cited artifact, and POL-RD-10(5) is not triggered. I did consider the driver's statement; it points to no artifact and no clause and does not change any figure.

No referral issues. The single ERP line was genuinely crossed (nearest fix 0.0 m at 09:41:00), so there is no phantom line and POL-RD-09(4) is not engaged; and with no deviation there is no POL-RD-06(c) conduct referral. The driver's profile carries no repeat-deviation pattern (deviation_flags_90d 0 over 250 completed trips), and I expressly do not rely on any context-only profile field.

To the rider and the driver. The booking was an upfront-quoted trip (fare_breakdown EV-FARE-00533: fare_model UPFRONT_QUOTE, quoted_fare_sgd 29.00, total_charged 51.30), so the distance and time charges were fixed at booking. POL-RD-02 does not run on an upfront fare, and no per-kilometre or per-minute refund is available to the rider. On this record the drive did not deviate either: the governing GPS polyline (EV-GPS-00533, 14.57 km) exceeds the booked optimal (EV-TRIP-00533, 14.20 km) by 0.37 km, or 2.6%, which is below both POL-RD-01 gates of 0.8 km and 20%. No deviation and no material deviation are established, and the driver's account that he drove the normal route is consistent with the trace. His further remark that 'the app added something at the end' points to no route fact and decides nothing.

The charge that is wrong is the one over the quote. The card was charged 51.30 against a fixed quote of 29.00, a difference of 22.30. Under POL-RD-11(a) the rider still pays the lines properly chargeable under POL-RD-09: the single ERP gantry CTE (Ang Mo Kio Ave 1 towards City) of SGD 3.00, which the driver's own trace crossed (nearest fix 0.0 m at 09:41 on EV-GPS-00533), an airport surcharge of 0.00 (this trip began at Yishun MRT, not an airport) and a waiting-time fee of 0.00. The refund is therefore 51.30 − 29.00 − 3.00 = SGD 19.30, rounded up to the nearest 0.05, and I order it paid to the rider. I note the rider's message says support already adjusted the bill, but the ledger still shows payment_status CHARGED with refund_issued_sgd 0.00, so on the present state the correction has not been applied and is ordered now.

On the remaining points: EV-ADVIS-00533-01 is MISSING with weight_multiplier 0.0 (issue MISSING_ARTIFACT), so no traffic advisory covers this corridor and POL-RD-03 cannot be run; because neither party asserts an external traffic cause, this is a gap in the bundle under POL-RD-13 and not a POL-RD-10(5) escalation. POL-RD-04 is also unavailable, because the chat log (EV-CHAT-00533) is empty — no message, no waypoint_hint — so nothing on the route can be charged to a rider request. The trace is clean under POL-RD-07 (157 fixes, 10 s cadence, gaps array empty, max gap 0.0 s), and the fare ledger carries the deciding figures at weight 1.0, so no POL-RD-10 trigger fires and confidence is not capped below the 0.70 floor. No repeat-deviation pattern exists (driver_profile.deviation_flags_90d 0 over 250 completed trips), so there is no POL-RD-06(c) conduct referral and no uplift, and there is no phantom gantry or wrongly applied surcharge, so no POL-RD-09(4) billing-integrity referral. The context-only profile fields mentioned in argument (rating, prior_deviation_flags) were not used as grounds by either side.

Outcome: PARTIAL_REFUND of SGD 19.30 to the rider; no driver compensation; no referral.

To the rider and the driver. This booking was an upfront-quote trip (EV-FARE-00533, fare_model UPFRONT_QUOTE), so the price was fixed at booking at SGD 29.00, and your card was charged SGD 51.30. On an upfront-quoted fare the distance and time charges cannot be reopened — POL-RD-02 does not run — and the only thing that may sit on top of the quote is a pass-through line genuinely incurred. No driver compensation arises: 14.6 km was billed against a 14.57 km trace, no shortfall. The rider's counter profile (deviation_claims_60d 0) does not trigger the extra-corroboration condition. The open question for the reviewer — why the platform rendered a metered fare of 51.30 on a 29.00 upfront booking — is noted here but produces no referral, because no clause directs one.
